decisive_items: diffuse intimal thickening with narrowing at the origins of the brachiocephalic, right common carotid, and left subclavian arteries
a bruit was audible over the left subclavian fossa
pulses in both upper limbs were deficient and blood pressure could not be measured
response.rationale: R3 is the only candidate that explains the vascular findings, including absent pulses, bruit, and CTA showing large vessel narrowing, consistent with Takayasu arteritis. R2 (anemia of chronic disease) explains the anemia but not the vascular syndrome. R1 is contradicted by elevated ferritin. R4 is unsupported by fundoscopy findings.

rejected.why: Iron deficiency anemia is contradicted by elevated serum ferritin (315.5 ng/mL) and does not explain the vascular findings.
Hypertensive retinopathy is unsupported; blood pressure was not measurable and fundoscopy shows optic-disk cupping, not typical hypertensive changes.
